business_summary: FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber components in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company operates through Industrial Materials, Fabric Processing Products, Sporting Goods, and Other segments. The company manufactures and sells industrial materials, including pneumatic control equipment, anti-vibration table and peripheral equipment, electrical and electronic equipment, rescue and lifesaving equipment, and carbon golf shafts. It also offers gas/water housing equipment, connection materials, and materials for speakers. In addition, the company provides automobiles, such as check valves; automotive parts; calendared rubber; industrial equipment, including duct quarter vent rubber/butterfly, and BF and AB cylinders; calendared rubber, such as anti-vibration system, rubber coated fabric, and pressure regulator; ultra-low hardness material and anti-vibration rubber products; paper roll airbags; conductive rubber, and textile/material for clothing. Further, it offers emergency magnesium air batteries; blade protective sheets for wind turbine; various functional tapes and molded products, cold shrink tube, and conservators for electric; LIM molded products; dialyzers, infusion, and blood circuits; check valves; regulator; flow control valve; latex products; disaster-relief tents, air tents, and inflatable life rafts and jackets; golf shaft for golf clubs; caravan shoes for trekking, hiking, trail running, and nordic walking; stream walking and climbing; and climbing/bouldering shoes. The company was formerly known as Fujikura Rubber Ltd. and changed its name to FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. in April 2019. FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
